intro: One of the most-asked questions for this trip: how do you actually get from Bangkok to Pattaya? Here are your options compared, with the honest pick for most travelers.

blocks.html: Short answer: Pattaya is close to Bangkok — about 1.5 to 2 hours by road. The easiest options are a minivan or bus from Ekkamai or Mochit, or a taxi/Grab if you are a group. No need to fly; it is too close.

blocks.html: If you are a couple or small group with luggage, a taxi or Grab is easiest — straight to your hotel. Solo or on a budget, the bus from Ekkamai is comfortable and reliable. Minivans are quick but sometimes wait to fill up.

faq.q: How long is Bangkok to Pattaya?
faq.a: About 1.5 to 2 hours by road, depending on traffic leaving Bangkok. Friday evenings are usually busier than normal.

faq.q: Is there transport straight from Suvarnabhumi Airport to Pattaya?
faq.a: Yes — there is an airport–Pattaya bus, plus transfer and taxi services straight from Suvarnabhumi to Pattaya, so you do not need to go into Bangkok first.
